server_removed: Connected server was removed from subscription
name: Name
kill_switch_help: Blocks all traffic except to your server if the proxy stops. Needs ./install.sh --helper.
dns_help: Routes DNS through the tunnel when using enhanced protection.
auto_connect_help: Reconnects to your last server when you log in.
url_invalid: Enter a link that starts with http:// or https://
subs_empty_hint: Add a subscription link to load your servers.
blocked_sub: Kill switch is holding traffic. Reconnect or release.
ks_failed: Could not change the firewall rules
ks_release_failed: Could not release the kill switch. Traffic is still blocked
core_timeout: The proxy core did not start in time
real_ping_failed: Real delay test unavailable, using TCP ping
no_link: No link saved. Update the subscription
mode_help: System proxy covers apps that follow GNOME proxy settings. TUN captures everything but needs a one-time ./install.sh --tun.
auto_update_help: How often servers are refreshed in the background.
routing_help: Comma-separated. Applied on next connect. LAN and private addresses are always direct.
tls_skip_help: Unsafe. Only for servers with self-signed certificates that the link does not mark as insecure.
all_disabled_hint: Turn one on in Settings, Subscriptions.
best_probing: Measuring servers to pick the best…
bulk_help: One subscription link per line (http:// or https://). Duplicates and links over the limit are skipped.
ping_probes_help: Median of several probes; the first successful one is discarded as warm-up.
stale_help: Old results are dimmed and never used by Best.
bulk_result: {a} added, {d} duplicate, {i} invalid, {l} over the limit
toggle_position_help: Choose where the Qurp tile sits in the Quick Settings menu. It applies right away.
toggle_position_hint: This is your real Quick Settings layout. Click any tile to put Qurp there.
placement_unknown: Open the Quick Settings menu once to load your real tile layout.
move_no_reply: Setting saved, but the shell didn't respond. Log out and back in to load the new version.
best_already: Already on the best server: {name} ({ms} ms)
core_too_old: sing-box is too old (needs 1.12 or newer)
port_busy: The local proxy port is already in use
clash_unsupported: Clash YAML subscriptions are not supported; use the plain link or sing-box JSON format
ks_blocks_ping: Kill switch is on: other servers cannot be tested. Turn it off or disconnect first
auto_reconnect_help: When the core dies, the tunnel stops answering or the network changes
auto_connect_best_help: At login, measure the servers and connect to the fastest instead of the last used one
tls_fragment_help: Splits the ClientHello into several records to get past simple DPI filtering
check_updates_help: Asks GitHub twice a day. The version chip in the panel still checks when clicked
dns_bootstrap_help: IP address. Used to find the server and for domains routed direct
dns_remote_help: IP address. Used with DNS leak protection and always in TUN mode
sub_user_agent_help: Leave empty for the Qurp default. Some panels answer differently per client name
ks_direct_ignored: Kill switch is on: direct rules for domains and apps are not applied
core_log_verbose_help: Writes every connection (destination domains included) to the log. Off by default: it is your browsing history
